Ratio — Innate Technique (1st level)

You were born with a powerful technique that creates a weak spot on a 7:3 ratio

Beginning at 1st level, you gain a +1 to critical range. Additionally, you roll an additional damage dice on a critical hit.

jjk5e.automationNotes: Extra critical dice: add them on the weapon (Extra Critical Damage field), e.g. 1 at 1st, 3 at 3rd, 4 at 6th, 5 at 11th.

effects.name: Critical Focus
effects.description: +1 critical range. Extra crit dice: 1 (+2 at 3rd, +3 at 6th, +4 at 11th, +5 in the domain).
